breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The user's request incorrectly specified both RAS and LES models. The agent resolved this by selecting a single, valid turbulence model: 'RANS k-Epsilon'. It completely removed any mention of an LES model, thus fixing the contradiction.
